description: 20-task golden eval set for JobScout v1-v4. Four categories of 5 tasks each: search, multi-step, fit analysis, edge cases. Fit-analysis tasks (11-15) require v4's MCP integration with CareerTailor — earlier versions cannot pass them.

categories.search: Basic search, filtering, and retrieval. Single-tool calls with simple decompositions.
categories.multi_step: Multi-step reasoning: fetch-then-search, comparison, multi-filter. Tests planner decisions and tool orchestration.
categories.fit_analysis: Resume-vs-job fit scoring through CareerTailor MCP. Only v4 can attempt these; v1-v3 should return analyzer-only answers without scores.
categories.edge_cases: Refusals, vague queries, and out-of-scope requests. Tests honest refusal and loop termination.

tasks.query: Find me Python jobs in Seattle
tasks.expected_behavior: Search by Python keyword + Seattle location. Return matching jobs with title, company, URL.

tasks.query: Find me 3 ML engineer roles at startups
tasks.expected_behavior: Search ML/engineer keywords. Return up to 3 results. Acknowledge that 'startup' filter is not natively supported.

tasks.query: Senior backend roles paying over $200k
tasks.expected_behavior: Search senior backend, fetch descriptions, post-filter by salary >= 200000.

tasks.query: Remote roles, no PhD required
tasks.expected_behavior: Search remote roles, fetch descriptions, filter for jobs where PhD is not required.

tasks.query: Find me roles like the one at https://example.com/jobs/job_001
tasks.expected_behavior: Direct fetch on job_001, then describe similar roles based on the fetched description.

tasks.query: Compare these two listings: job_001 and job_003
tasks.expected_behavior: Two direct fetches, side-by-side structured comparison.

tasks.query: What's hot in AI hiring this week?
tasks.expected_behavior: Vague query. Either ask for clarification or interpret reasonably without infinite loop. Should not invent data.

tasks.query: Find me jobs but only at companies under 50 people
tasks.expected_behavior: Refuse cleanly — company size is not in tool data. Do not invent results.

tasks.query: Senior MLE under $180k that don't require a PhD
tasks.expected_behavior: Search senior MLE, fetch descriptions, apply two post-fetch filters (salary, PhD).

tasks.query: Save my top 3 to a file
tasks.expected_behavior: Refuse cleanly via planner refusal_reason. No save tool exists.

tasks.query: How well does my resume match the job at https://example.com/jobs/job_001?
tasks.expected_behavior: v4: fetch job_001, set analyze_fit_for, return CareerTailor fit score with matching/missing keywords. v1-v3: should return analyzer's best-effort answer without a real fit score.

tasks.query: Rank these jobs by fit for me: job_001 and job_003
tasks.expected_behavior: v4: fetch both URLs, two parallel CareerTailor calls, ranked output with scores. v1-v3: cannot rank by fit, should not invent scores.

tasks.query: Which Seattle Python job is the best fit for me?
tasks.expected_behavior: v4: search Seattle+Python, fetch results, run fit analysis on each, return the highest-scoring one. Compound: search + fit. v1-v3: search returns results, no fit ranking.

tasks.query: Why is my resume a poor fit for job_002?
tasks.expected_behavior: v4: fetch job_002, run fit analysis, surface missing_keywords and reasoning. Tests retrieval of CareerTailor's structured 'missing' field. v1-v3: cannot answer authoritatively.

tasks.query: Find me roles I'm at least 70% match for
tasks.expected_behavior: Genuinely hard: requires search + fetch + fit + threshold filter. v4: deliberate failure expected — the planner has no native threshold-filter mechanism for fit scores. Documents the next bottleneck for future versions. v1-v3: cannot attempt at all.

tasks.query: Show me 5 jobs in payments
tasks.expected_behavior: Search 'payments' keyword, return up to 5 job results with title, company, URL.

tasks.query: Junior frontend roles, remote only
tasks.expected_behavior: Search frontend with junior seniority + remote filter. Return matching roles.

tasks.query: Jobs at Initech
tasks.expected_behavior: Filter jobs by company. Return all Initech roles with title and URL.

tasks.query: What's the email for HR at job_001?
tasks.expected_behavior: Refuse cleanly — contact information is not in tool data. Do not invent an email address.

tasks.query: Update my resume to match job_001
tasks.expected_behavior: Refuse cleanly — JobScout has no resume-modification tool. Even with CareerTailor wrapped via MCP, this MCP server only exposes analyze_job_fit, not resume rewriting. Should not attempt to edit anything.
